    {
      "id": "D1",
      "timestamp": "2026-09-01",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "Product archetype. Skill + reconstruction artifact first (M1), package/validator/CLI next (M2), FilePress site on gaplast.dev later (M3).",
      "rationale": "GENESIS §15. The prohibition is the product. M1 already exists in this folder. Do not invent a stack that skips the order.",
      "alternatives_considered": ["Scaffold a web app first", "Ship CLI before the skill can run"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D2",
      "timestamp": "2026-09-01",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "Markdown reconstruction is the source of truth. JSON is a projection for tests and a future CLI.",
      "rationale": "GENESIS §7. The reconstruction is the format. Do not wrap another app's disk format.",
      "alternatives_considered": ["JSON-first artifact", "ACH matrix as native format"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D3",
      "timestamp": "2026-09-01",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "House stack: TypeScript, ESM only, pnpm, Node 20+. package.json name gaplast, private until Sam publishes.",
      "rationale": "GENESIS N5 and house defaults. Agents never npm publish. gaplast@0.0.0 is a name hold, not this tree.",
      "alternatives_considered": ["Python CLI", "CommonJS"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D4",
      "timestamp": "2026-09-01",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "Site engine is FilePress (getfilepress) under site/. Do not hand-roll. Do not scaffold in M1.",
      "rationale": "GENESIS F23 / §17. House pattern matches smellcheck. FilePress is markdown → static build, no admin UI, no database.",
      "alternatives_considered": ["Bespoke SvelteKit marketing site", "PocketBase-backed app"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D5",
      "timestamp": "2026-09-01",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "LocalSlip names local ports when a FilePress or CLI preview is running. FilePress already uses ensure-lease.",
      "rationale": "Sam named LocalSlip for this project. localhost is the machine; LocalSlip is the slip. Prevents Vite port shuffle from breaking bookmarks.",
      "alternatives_considered": ["Hardcoded 5173", "No named local host"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D6",
      "timestamp": "2026-09-01",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "Local-first. No PocketBase, no auth, no runtime LLM API in this repo for v1.",
      "rationale": "GENESIS N1–N2, F20–F22. Reconstructions are produced by the user's agent following the skill. CLI validates; it does not call a model.",
      "alternatives_considered": ["Runtime LLM API", "Accounts and sync"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D7",
      "timestamp": "2026-09-01",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "Source gathering: user packet plus named URLs only. No unsolicited browsing for a cause.",
      "rationale": "GENESIS §7.4 / Q1. Too much fetching turns the tool into a generic research assistant.",
      "alternatives_considered": ["Live web search API in v1"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D8",
      "timestamp": "2026-09-01",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "Confidence is settled / provisional / open. No 0–100 scores in v1.",
      "rationale": "GENESIS Q2 / E14.",
      "alternatives_considered": ["Numeric confidence"]
    },
    {

      "rationale": "Sam: unpublished drafts should not be on gaplast.dev. GENESIS is the builder spec, not a public manual.",
      "alternatives_considered": ["Keep /spec and /paper as generated pages", "Publish a thinned public spec page"]
    },

      "rationale": "Sam said purge what we need, then B, then that the repo will be public.",
